reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) supports the existence of Al-Ni driven clustering in Al0.1CrCoFeNi, but provides no data on how clustering affects electron density, electron–phonon coupling, or superconductivity. The key mechanistic premises linking clustering to superconductivity are entirely unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Al0.1CrCoFeNi exhibits chemical clustering driven by Al-Ni pair correlations
Clustering can be modified by heat treatment (quenching vs. annealing)
